Now I see the key issue! In `xmlXIncludeLoadFallback` at line 1949:
```c
ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc = fallback->children;
```

This directly assigns `fallback->children` without copying. The fallback node is part of the main document, so its children are also part of the main document. When `xmlXIncludeIncludeNode` processes this, it will move these nodes into the document and then free the fallback node. But the `inc` pointer still references the fallback's children.
